description: This file defines an Android-specific Kotlin class 'SmsManager' responsible for sending SMS messages, querying SMS/MMS messages, handling permissions, and interfacing with Android content providers related to telephony and contacts.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: A class managing SMS/MMS sending and querying, handling permissions, and interfacing with Android telephony content providers.

classes.name: SmsManager.SendResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an SMS send attempt.

classes.name: SmsMessage
classes.description: Data class representing an SMS message with relevant metadata.

classes.name: SearchResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of an SMS query, including messages and metadata.

classes.name: QueryMetadata
classes.description: Data class containing metadata about the SMS query, particularly related to MMS inclusion.

classes.name: ParsedParams
classes.description: Data class representing parsed parameters for sending an SMS.

classes.name: QueryParams
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters for SMS querying.

classes.name: ParseResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing the success or failure of parsing send parameters.

classes.name: QueryParseResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing the success or failure of parsing query parameters.

classes.name: SendPlan
classes.description: Data class describing how to send an SMS, including parts and whether multipart is needed.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has SEND_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_CONTACTS permission.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can send SMS based on permissions and device features.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can perform SMS search operations.

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Determines if the app can read SMS, equivalent to canSearchSms.

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Checks if the device has telephony hardware.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester to handle runtime permission requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Suspending function to send an SMS message, returning the result.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Suspending function to query SMS/MMS messages based on specified parameters.

methods.name: ensureSmsPermission
methods.description: Ensures that SEND_SMS permission is granted, requesting if necessary.

methods.name: ensureReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Ensures that READ_SMS permission is granted, requesting if necessary.

methods.name: ensureReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Ensures that READ_CONTACTS permission is granted, requesting if necessary.

methods.name: okResult
methods.description: Constructs a successful SendResult object.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs a failed SendResult object with error info.

methods.name: queryOk
methods.description: Constructs a successful SearchResult with messages and metadata.

methods.name: queryError
methods.description: Constructs a failed SearchResult with an error message.

methods.name: getPhoneNumbersFromContactName
methods.description: Retrieves phone numbers from contacts matching the contact name.

methods.name: querySmsMessages
methods.description: Queries SMS messages based on provided parameters and contact numbers.

methods.name: querySmsMmsMessagesByPhone
methods.description: Queries MMS messages associated with a specific phone number.

methods.name: getMmsTextBody
methods.description: Retrieves text body of an MMS message part.

methods.name: getMmsMeta
methods.description: Retrieves MMS message box info and read status.

methods.name: getMmsAddress
methods.description: Retrieves preferred MMS address for a message.
